do_not_assume: Confirm GET endpoints do not modify data.
goal: Complete Determine Whether A Helix App Is Public-Safe with evidence-backed checks and a verifiable outcome.
steps: Identify every endpoint.
Mark each endpoint read-only or write/destructive.
Confirm GET endpoints do not modify data.
Confirm public endpoints expose only public data.
Confirm identifiers use GUIDs or IdKeys where appropriate.
Confirm direct endpoint calls cannot access unauthorized records.
Confirm SQL input is sanitized or removed.
Confirm no sensitive attribute security bypass exists.
Confirm cache settings cannot leak personalized fragments.
Document residual risk.
title: Recipe: Determine Whether A Helix App Is Public-Safe
